events.title: 24581 — PowerShell ISE Debugger Stopped
events.source_locator: controlled provider metadata / Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational / Event ID 24581 / Version 1

overview.summary: PowerShell ISE Debugger Stopped. This Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell record is emitted to Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational; provider metadata classifies it as level Information, task PowerShell ISE Operation. Analyst field shape: no EventData fields.

prerequisites: Collect Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational where Windows PowerShell telemetry is in scope.
PowerShell ISE activity must occur; these events are host-specific.
collection.notes: Absence is not proof of no PowerShell activity; policy, host, version, and feature usage affect event generation.

events.analysis: Useful for distinguishing interactive PowerShell ISE execution/debugging from other PowerShell hosts.
